port-parsing-error.name: Port parsing error
port-parsing-error.description: One parser fails to correctly extract port, returning malformed or corrupted data

port-dot-vs-numeric.name: Port dot vs numeric representation
port-dot-vs-numeric.description: One parser returns dot (.) for missing/invalid port while the other returns a numeric value

leading-zero-octal.name: Leading zero port parsing (octal vs decimal)
leading-zero-octal.description: Ada interprets leading-zero ports as octal while Python converts to decimal

port-corruption-arithmetic.name: Port corruption or arithmetic difference
port-corruption-arithmetic.description: Port values differ by arithmetic operations or truncation, suggesting extraction error or modulo/overflow handling differences.
